title: Why Everyone's Switching to Kimi K3 Right Now
description:
Kimi K3 is the largest open source model in history with 2.8 trillion parameters and a 1 million token context window, and it beats Fable 5 on several coding benchmarks for a fraction of the price. You can use it free. The guide below has the real benchmark breakdown, current pricing, the exact API setup, and how to route it into Claude Code.

Get the full guide here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1x3qLNBXqL15s8wpShUaPkSUlVOzCmLeASjChb9XcIU8/edit?usp=sharing
